$description: Tier 3 · Component knobs for the chat area (packages/ui: composer.tsx, chat-message.tsx, artifact-card.tsx, summary-block.tsx, prose.tsx, code-block.tsx, status-orb.tsx, indicator.tsx, run-trace.tsx, security/agent-prompt.tsx), merged with component.json at build and emitted as --c-*. It re-declares the StatusOrb and Indicator colours and the Indicator's dot size from component.json, because the 2026-11 restyle (contract §5.1) moves them onto the new roles: live is secondary-live, needs-you is the yellow with its ink, marks are squares. The other sizes in these parts (the 40px send button and artifact tile, the 2px edge, padding 12 / 16) sit on the 4px spacing scale, the size roles and the stroke roles, and the Artifact Card's hover and pressed are the state roles themselves, so they need no knob.

bubble-max.$description: The widest a person's bubble grows (300px). Figma draws the bubble fixed at 300; the contract (§5.1) has it hug its text up to this.

max-lines.$description: How many lines of the `ui` role the field grows to before it scrolls inside itself (10 × 20px = 200px). Not drawn in Figma, which draws the empty state only.

status-orb.$description: StatusOrb, re-declared for the 2026-11 restyle. Still and finished states take the label ink; thinking and working take the app's live colour (the one motion reserved for agent activity); needs-you takes the yellow, with the yellow's own ink as an outline, because the yellow has no lightness contrast with the stone surfaces (Lc 0 on the ground) and a small yellow square alone does not show there.

queued.$description: A clock glyph: waiting its turn.

paused.$description: A pause glyph: on hold, and it picks up again.

stopped.$description: A stop glyph: someone ended it. Not a failure, so not critical.

needs-you.$description: The yellow, the same in every app.

needs-you-edge.$description: A 1px outline in the yellow's ink around the needs-you square, so the mark reads on stone, where the yellow alone has no lightness contrast.

done.$description: A check glyph. success keeps its accent ramp (contract §1.4).

indicator.$description: IndicatorMark, re-declared for the 2026-11 restyle. A dot is a square: unread is the ink square Figma draws on a message row (6 × 6, text-body); attention is the yellow square with a 1px ink outline (needs-you-edge), so it reads on stone. A badge is the count on the same two fills.

dot-size.$description: 6px: Figma's Unread mark (List Row, Message layout).

attention-edge.$description: The 1px ink outline on the attention square and the attention badge.

unread.$description: The unread square: ink, not the identity colour (Figma List Row).

unread-badge-bg.$description: Inverted ink, as an active Filter Chip (contract §6.5).
